description: Page selector for a paged list. Renders a windowed range, never every page.

pageCount.description: How many pages there are. Required, and guarded at runtime: a Pagination with no page count renders a window over nothing.

ariaLabel.description: Names this navigation landmark. Two paginated tables in one dashboard is a routine layout, and until this member existed both carried the identical hardcoded name and were not distinguishable — Pagination.behaviour.json's roles.label exception is what recorded that. Say what is being paged — "Deployments", not "Pages". Optional so the existing call sites keep working, which means the constant default still stands wherever a caller omits it and the exception is narrowed rather than retired.

change.description: A page was chosen; carries the new 1-based page. Never fires for the current page, nor for a page outside 1..pageCount.
